cases.name: construction-name
cases.description: sets name to the concrete subclass name

cases.name: construction-message
cases.description: sets message correctly

cases.name: construction-code
cases.description: sets code correctly

cases.name: construction-default-retryable
cases.description: sets retryable to false by default

cases.name: construction-omitted-optional-args
cases.description: applies BaseError defaults when a subclass omits optional constructor fields

cases.name: construction-explicit-retryable
cases.description: sets retryable to true when specified

cases.name: construction-timestamp
cases.description: sets timestamp within reasonable range

cases.name: construction-correlation-id
cases.description: sets correlationId when provided

cases.name: construction-correlation-id-absent
cases.description: leaves correlationId undefined when not provided

cases.name: construction-metadata
cases.description: freezes metadata and makes it available

cases.name: construction-metadata-nested
cases.description: freezes nested metadata and preserves nested structures

cases.name: construction-metadata-absent
cases.description: leaves metadata undefined when not provided

cases.name: construction-cause
cases.description: stores cause in the Error.cause chain

cases.name: construction-instanceof
cases.description: is instanceof Error and instanceof BaseError

cases.name: to-user-message-default
cases.description: returns message by default

cases.name: to-user-message-custom
cases.description: uses subclass formatter when overridden

cases.name: json-required-fields
cases.description: returns all required fields

cases.name: json-code-message
cases.description: serializes code and message

cases.name: json-correlation-null
cases.description: includes correlationId as null when absent

cases.name: json-correlation-value
cases.description: includes correlationId value when present

cases.name: json-recursive-cause
cases.description: serializes cause chain recursively

cases.name: json-depth-sentinel
cases.description: uses sentinel string when chain exceeds depth limit

cases.name: json-native-error-cause
cases.description: serializes a native Error cause with code native.error

cases.name: json-primitive-cause
cases.description: serializes a primitive cause with code native.primitive

cases.name: json-roundtrip
cases.description: produces JSON-serializable output

cases.name: find-cause-of-type-hit
cases.description: finds the first matching cause type in the chain

cases.name: find-cause-of-type-self
cases.description: returns the inspected error when it already matches the requested type

cases.name: find-cause-of-type-miss
cases.description: returns undefined when no cause matches the requested type

cases.name: find-cause-of-type-primitive
cases.description: returns undefined when the chain ends in a primitive cause

cases.name: cause-chain
cases.description: returns the full cause chain in order

cases.name: cause-chain-primitive
cases.description: stops the cause chain at a primitive cause

cases.name: has-cause-of-type-hit
cases.description: returns true when the chain contains the requested type

cases.name: has-cause-of-type-miss
cases.description: returns false when the chain does not contain the requested type

cases.name: to-message-native-error
cases.description: returns message from native errors

cases.name: to-message-primitive
cases.description: stringifies primitive values

cases.name: to-serialized-error
cases.description: returns the canonical serialized error object
